description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-24 when road-to-a-claim-that-is-not-a-key 4.2 added a per-tool authority block, which brought this skill into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover a TypeScript server, a FastMCP server, tool schema design, the evaluation set, and a German phrasing. Near-misses: wiring an existing server into a host (mcp), listing configured servers (mcp), and reviewing who may call an endpoint (authz-review). Counterexamples guard 'server' and 'tool' in unrelated senses.

queries.q: build an MCP server in TypeScript that exposes our ticket API as tools
write a FastMCP server with a search tool and an update tool
design the input schema and error handling for the tools of our MCP server
write the 10-question evaluation set for my MCP server
